payload.title: File:Fona Skeletal.svg
payload.description_html:
Composite skeletal diagram of Fona herzogae based on fossil material from the holotype and several referred specimens. Missing bones are informed using relatives including Thescelosaurus spp. and Oryctodromeus cubicularis. Note that extensive ossified tendons, especially on the tail (as in Oryctodromeus), are omitted to avoid obscuring the vertebrae. Scale generally corresponds to the holotype specimen (NCSM 33548) and other materials from the 'Mini Troll' locality. Scale bar=50 cm.

References

  • "A new semi-fossorial thescelosaurine dinosaur from the Cenomanian-age Mussentuchit Member of the Cedar Mountain Formation, Utah"
  • "The cranial anatomy of the neornithischian dinosaur Thescelosaurus neglectus"
  • "Osteology of Thescelosaurus, an orthopodous dinosaur from the Lance Formation of Wyoming"
  • "Osteogenesis, homology, and function of the intercostal plates in ornithischian dinosaurs (Tetrapoda, Sauropsida)"
  • "The Osteology of Haya griva (Dinosauria: Ornithischia) from the Late Cretaceous of Mongolia"
  • Hypsilophodon musculature by Matt Dempsey
